about_the_game:
Welcome to the suburbs.
Everything looks perfect — until you take a closer look.

In CRIME LAWN REPEAT, you play as a man who moves to a quiet suburban neighborhood with his younger brother for reasons no one knows. New house, new neighbors, a fresh start... or so it seems. Behind the manicured lawns, friendly smiles, and backyard barbecues lie dirty secrets — and you might be one of them.

🕵️‍♂️ Explore a world of suburban irony
Meet the locals, get involved in their routines — and uncover what they’re really hiding. In this neighborhood, even the gnomes know more than they let on.

🌼 Live a double life
By day, you’re a caring brother and a polite neighbor. By night — someone who hides the evidence and digs for the truth. Your choices shape your reputation, and reputation defines your alliances.

🕶️ Pretending is your best outfit
Learn to lie, or play by the rules. Only you decide who your character becomes.

🧩 Nothing is ever simple
Casual gameplay mixed with a story full of twists, black humor, and suburban suspense.

Features:

  • A visual novel with branching paths and suburban satire

  • A unique visual style — from pastel facades to shadowy basements

  • Secret relationships, investigations, suspicious neighbors… and a bit of brotherly responsibility

  • Multiple endings based on your choices and the person you choose to become

short_description: Behind the perfectly trimmed lawn lies the perfect crime. In visual novel CRIME LAWN REPEAT you step into a world of suburban secrets, where every cheerful “good morning” might lead to an investigation. Water the flowers. Hide the evidence. Don’t get caught.
